company.name: Synvivia
company.shortDescription: Synvivia creates organisms that can be controlled with small molecules.
company.description: Synvivia makes ON-OFF switches for genetically engineered organisms. These protein switches are controlled by small molecules. By installing these switches into an organism, Synvivia creates engineered organisms that can be controlled with small molecules.

productsAndServices.description: Synvivia's technology enhances AAV yield and potency for gene therapy manufacturing, achieving a 3-10X improvement.
productsAndServices.name: AAV yield and potency optimization

productsAndServices.description: Improves the quality and infectiousness of AAVs, contributing to safer and more efficient gene therapies.

aiResearchSummary.text: Synvivia is researching methods and compositions for the production of recombinant viral vectors in host cells using engineered cyclic peptides, as described in 'Engineered cyclic peptides for enhancing viral production.' The approach focuses on increasing viral titer and transduction efficiency by employing engineered peptides, aligning with Synvivia’s focus on creating organisms that can be controlled with small molecules. This highlights their work in controllable biological systems and molecular modulation.
